name: zgeometry_model_get_linear_buffer_of_polygon_vertices
description: zGeometry_Model::GetLinearBufferOfPolygonVertices reallocates a linear zVec3 buffer and copies polygon-indexed model vertices into it.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zGeometry model source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x46b650 validates reallocating the caller buffer to (polygon->vertexCountAndFlags & 0xff) * sizeof(zVec3), walking polygon vertex indices, copying model->verts[index] triples into the linear output, and returning the output pointer.
The native model/bounds smoke verifies indexed vertex copy order from a null buffer and reuse through a resized existing buffer.
